name: Syncthing Tray
about: Tray application and Windows integration for Syncthing, showing sync status and giving quick access to controls.

name: Ventoy
about: Create a bootable USB drive once, then drop ISO files on it and choose which one to boot. No need to reformat for each image.

name: Rufus
about: Small utility to create bootable USB drives from ISO files, for installing or repairing operating systems.

name: balenaEtcher
description: Flash OS images to USB and SD cards
about: Flashes OS images to USB drives and SD cards safely, with validation and an easy three-step interface.

name: CrystalDiskInfo
description: Monitor disk health and SMART information
about: Shows the health, temperature and SMART status of your drives, helping you spot failing storage early.

name: CrystalDiskMark
about: Benchmarks the read and write speed of drives, so you can compare SSDs, HDDs and USB sticks.

name: HWiNFO
about: Detailed hardware information and real-time monitoring of temperatures, voltages and sensors. Free for personal use.

name: CPU-Z
about: Shows details about your processor, motherboard, memory and cache. A quick way to verify what hardware you have.

name: GPU-Z
about: Shows details and live sensor data for your graphics card, helpful for checking clocks, temperatures and load.

name: BCUninstaller
about: Bulk uninstaller that removes many programs at once and cleans up leftovers, including portable apps.

name: Revo Uninstaller Free
about: Uninstaller that removes programs and scans for leftover files and registry entries. The free edition has basic features.

name: UniGetUI
description: Graphical interface for Windows package managers
about: Graphical front end for Windows package managers like WinGet, Scoop and Chocolatey. Install, update and manage apps in one place.

name: WinSCP
description: SFTP, SCP and FTP file transfer client
about: File transfer client for SFTP, SCP and FTP with a two-panel interface and scripting support.

name: FileZilla Client
about: Popular FTP, FTPS and SFTP client with a simple interface and a transfer queue. Beware of bundled offers when downloading from third-party sites.

name: PuTTY
about: Lightweight SSH, Telnet and serial client for connecting to remote machines and devices.

name: MobaXterm Home Edition
about: All-in-one remote terminal with tabbed SSH, an X server and file browser. The Home edition is free for personal use.

name: Advanced IP Scanner
about: Quickly scans a local network to list devices, open shares and remote access options. Free, but not open source.

name: Angry IP Scanner
about: Fast and lightweight IP address and port scanner for local networks.

name: Nmap
about: Standard tool for network discovery and security auditing. Finds hosts, open ports and services.

name: ZeroTier One
description: Virtual networking and private network overlay
about: Creates virtual private networks between your devices so they behave as if on the same LAN, across the internet.

name: Tailscale
about: Easy mesh VPN built on WireGuard. Connects your devices securely with minimal setup. Free for personal use.

name: Proton VPN
about: VPN with a free tier and a strict no-logs policy from the makers of Proton Mail. Its apps are open source.

name: Malwarebytes
about: Anti-malware scanner that finds and removes threats. The free mode offers manual scanning only.

name: AdwCleaner
about: Removes adware, toolbars and potentially unwanted programs. No installation needed, just run and scan.

name: KeePass
about: Classic offline password manager that stores your passwords in an encrypted file, extensible with plugins.

name: Gpg4win
about: Windows bundle of OpenPGP tools for encrypting and signing emails and files, including the Kleopatra key manager.

name: OpenVPN Connect
about: Official client for connecting to OpenVPN servers, either your own or from a VPN provider.

name: Proton Pass
description: Password manager and secure identity vault
about: Password manager from Proton with email aliases, built-in 2FA codes and end-to-end encryption. The apps are open source.

name: Visual Studio Community
description: Full IDE for .NET, C++, game and desktop development
about: Full Microsoft IDE for .NET, C++ and game development. Free for individuals, open-source and small teams under the license terms.

name: JetBrains Toolbox
about: Installs, updates and manages JetBrains IDEs such as IntelliJ, PyCharm and WebStorm from one place.

name: IntelliJ IDEA Community
description: Java and Kotlin IDE community edition
about: Free edition of the IntelliJ IDE for Java and Kotlin, with smart code completion and refactoring.

name: PyCharm Community
about: Free edition of JetBrains' Python IDE, with debugging, testing and smart code assistance.

name: Android Studio
about: Google's official IDE for building Android apps, with an emulator, layout editor and profiling tools.

name: Postman
about: API platform for building, testing and documenting APIs. Free tier available; collaboration features are paid.

name: Insomnia
description: API client for HTTP, GraphQL and gRPC
about: API client for HTTP, GraphQL and gRPC with environments, code generation and plugins. Open core with optional cloud features.

name: Bruno
about: Open-source API client that stores collections as plain files in your repo, making them easy to version with Git.

name: HTTPie Desktop
about: Friendly desktop app for testing APIs from the makers of the HTTPie command-line tool. Open core product.

name: WinMerge
description: Compare and merge files and folders
about: Visual differencing and merging tool for files and folders, handy for comparing code and documents.

name: Beyond Compare
about: Polished tool for comparing files, folders and archives. Paid after a trial period.

name: TortoiseGit
about: Adds Git commands to Windows Explorer's right-click menu, with a graphical log, diff and commit dialogs.

name: GitHub CLI
about: GitHub from the command line. Create pull requests, review issues and manage repositories without leaving the terminal.

name: Git LFS
description: Manage large files in Git repositories
about: Git extension that stores large files such as media or datasets outside the main repository, keeping it small and fast.

name: CMake
about: Cross-platform build-system generator that is widely used for C and C++ projects.

name: Ninja
about: Small, extremely fast build system, often used together with CMake.

name: LLVM
about: Compiler infrastructure and toolchain, including Clang, used by many languages and tools.

name: Go
about: Official toolchain for the Go programming language. Simple, fast and well suited to servers and command-line tools.

name: Rustup
about: Installer and version manager for the Rust language. Manages compilers, targets and components.

name: Java 21 JDK Temurin
about: Eclipse Temurin build of OpenJDK 21 (LTS), a free, vendor-neutral Java development kit.

name: OpenJDK 25 Temurin
about: Eclipse Temurin build of OpenJDK 25, a free, vendor-neutral Java development kit.

name: Ruby
about: Ruby language with the RubyInstaller development kit for Windows. Popular for scripting and web apps with Rails.

name: PHP
about: The PHP runtime for developing and running web applications and command-line scripts.

name: Composer
about: Dependency manager for PHP. Declare the libraries your project needs and Composer installs and updates them.

name: PostgreSQL
about: Advanced open-source relational database server known for reliability, standards support and extensibility.
